name: How long does custom trim installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does custom trim installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of custom trim installation depends on the project's scope, including the total lineal feet of trim, the complexity of the profiles, and the number of rooms involved. A smaller project, like a single room's crown molding, might be completed in a day or two, while a whole-house trim upgrade could take several days to a week. During the initial project assessment, Maine Results, Inc. provides an estimated timeline, considering factors like material availability and necessary prep work to give you a clear understanding of the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom trim installation time varies by project size and complexity; a single room may take days, while a whole house can take a week.
